links.outcome: Correct abstention on unanswerable questions by gpt-oss-20B
links.effect: gpt-oss-20B correctly abstained on 69% of one hundred unanswerable questions, so about 31% produced SQL instead of abstaining.
links.quote: on a matched sample of one hundred unanswerable questions, where correct behavior is to abstain rather than produce SQL, gpt-oss-20B correctly abstained on 69%.

unlisted_practices: Returning the underlying SQL query alongside results so users can verify outputs
Local deployment of an open-weights model to keep sensitive clinical data private

screen.reason: Evaluates M3, an LLM-based system for querying electronic health records (MIMIC-IV) using the EHRSQL benchmark and testing abstention on unanswerable questions.
